body2Diagnosis.conclusion: The B2 shell is present at runtime (1076 verts, healthy per-vertex alpha median 0.25, same material/consumption as Aisha probe-verified live) and covers the globe (+0.3mm proud, same as Aisha), but its shadow over body2's visible sclera band is ~6x weaker (differential beauty-minus-noshell median dL -5.6 vs Aisha -36.7; upper-limbus quadrant -1.05 vs -35.7; canthal quadrants do respond, -15/-16). The baked field concentrates alpha canthally and zeroes the lower-central pocket (lower-atten x pocket gate), so the visible effect is hypersensitive to where the rendered opening falls: body2's opening maps to near-zero-alpha territory (3D-mapped matched baked-alpha median 0.00 vs Aisha 0.45, 85%+ pixels matched within 1.5mm). M2b therefore cannot respond on body2 no matter the strength: raising strength only deepens the canthi (M2a up) and grey-veils the median (M1/D90 overshoot, G2 fail). No subject-specific constant was introduced; the pocket/gate/atten interplay is generic.
